units.source: The Critters of the area are inspired by your promiscuity! Occasionally, critters will show up in pairs by Maverick’s Shop and be hanging out! Be sure to talk with them and see how they are doing!
units.target: Зверушек вдохновили твои любовные похождения! Иногда у магазина Маверика можно встретить парочки. Поговори с ними и узнай, как у них дела!
units.assessment: «любовные похождения» retains the adult/flirtatious multiple-romance implication of promiscuity without adding explicit acts. Inspiration/agency, occasional pair appearance by Maverick’s shop, and invitation to talk/check how they are doing are retained. «парочки» naturally conveys pairs spending time together. Local ambient critters remain clear in scene context. No obligatory dating or gender invention.

units.source: Dates are unlocked over time. Some may require certain quests or gossips to unlock. Some dates will continue over multiple meets!

units.assessment: The revised full body preserves time-based unlocks, conditional requirements for specific quests OR specific conversations, and continuation of some date stories over subsequent meetings. «провести определённые беседы» implements glossary tfol-055 without changing the feature into rumors; «выполнить определённые задания» retains the required specificity. Natural concise Russian, no source facts added or omitted. RU-DATES-01 resolved.

units.source: When critters are “on a date” – They won’t be able to do Quests, OR gossips. You will need to locate them in their normal locations for that. Besides… it would be quite rude to bother them during their date!
units.target: Пока зверушки на свидании, задания и Беседы с ними недоступны. Для этого ищи их в обычных местах. Да и мешать им на свидании было бы невежливо!
units.assessment: The revised full body states temporary quest and Беседы unavailability with those critters while they are on a date, without narrowing the restriction to quest giving. It preserves normal-location instructions and the politeness warning. «Беседы» identifies the game system and avoids contradicting Page1’s ordinary invitation to talk. Natural Russian and source agency/conditions retained. RU-DATES-02 resolved.
